dcat_keyword_sm: Routes--Conception et construction--Conditions par temps froid
dct_creator_sm: L.U.C.I.L. - Laboratoire universitaire sur les chaussées et les infrastructures linéaires (Universite Laval).
dct_description_sm: The data were measured in the active layer and the backfill material of a section of the Inuvik Tuktoyaktuk Highway (NWT, Canada) road embankment built on permafrost. Dataset consists of soil temperature and moisture, soil modulus obtained with a dynamic penetrometer (PANDA) and a portable deflectometer (LWD); stress and strain generated in both layers by the passage of a heavy vehicle at various speed and thaw period.
dct_title_s: Seasonal analysis of road embankments built on permafrost: the case of the Inuvik Tuktoyaktuk Highway
